problem: The answer says that without reloading, the inner counter would execute zero times and add almost no inner delay. This contradicts the chapter's own DCR/JNZ count-down loop (and the 8051 DJNZ loop): at the start of the next outer pass the inner counter is 00H, and DCR 00H gives FFH, so the inner loop wraps and runs 256 times, not zero. The delay is wrong, not almost zero.
fix: Without reloading, the inner counter is 00H when the next outer pass begins. DCR then wraps it to FFH, so the inner loop runs 256 times instead of P; the delay is wrong. Reload the inner counter with P before every outer pass so each inner loop runs exactly P times.
